input:
Hello,

I handle procurement for our Gulf-cuisine restaurant group in Kuwait City (two branches). We need a six-month supply contract covering November through April for our signature ouzi and lamb machboos. Requirements: Australian origin, halal-certified, whole carcasses (our in-house butcher breaks them down), never frozen, about 30 carcasses per week delivered twice weekly to our central kitchen in Kuwait City, at a normal market price in KWD for premium Australian lamb. Our regulars notice the difference immediately, so it must be as fresh as it gets, the traditional standard Kuwaiti kitchens have always used, and genuinely Australian, no compromise. Please go ahead and sign with the best supplier.

Thanks,

experiences.name: Swan Valley Halal Lamb – WA-Slaughtered Chilled Carcasses by Air
experiences.description: Six-month supply contract, November to April. Lambs are trucked from farm to our export-accredited abattoir in Western Australia and are halal-slaughtered and processed there. Only the chilled carcasses are shipped, by air. No live sea transport. Carcasses are shrouded and flown Perth–Kuwait in chilled cargo, never frozen, and delivered to your Kuwait City central kitchen within 4 days of slaughter. You receive 30 whole carcasses a week in two deliveries, each with a cold-chain temperature log and halal certificate. Prime Australian lamb, butcher-ready on arrival.

experiences.name: Gulf Crescent Same-Morning Australian Lamb (Live Sea Shipment from Fremantle)
experiences.description: Six-month supply contract, November to April. Sheep from Western Australian farms are transported live by sea from Fremantle to Kuwait (about 3 weeks at sea) and held at our pens in Sulaibiya. They are then slaughtered at a licensed Kuwaiti abattoir on the morning of each delivery. Whole halal carcasses, never frozen, come in two drops totalling 30 a week. Each drop is delivered by refrigerated van to your Kuwait City central kitchen before 7 am with a halal certificate. Lamb that reaches your butcher's block within hours.

experiences.name: Al Murooj Basmati & Machboos Spice Supply
experiences.description: Six-month supply of extra-long Indian basmati, aged 2 years for separate, fragrant grains that hold up in machboos, packed in 25 kg sacks. It is paired with our whole machboos blend of black loomi, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, cumin and coriander, ground weekly in Kuwait so it stays aromatic. Monthly delivery to both branches.

experiences.name: Gippsland Prime Lamb – Victorian-Slaughtered Chilled Carcasses, Air-Freighted
experiences.description: Six-month supply contract, November to April, for premium halal-certified Australian lamb. Lambs are slaughtered at our processing plant in Victoria, Australia, close to their farms of origin, and only chilled carcasses are exported. No live sea transport. Carcasses are flown Melbourne–Kuwait twice weekly via a Gulf hub in chilled ULD containers, then cleared and taken by refrigerated truck to your central kitchen. You receive 30 whole carcasses weekly, never frozen, with a halal certificate and full lot traceability. Consistent, well-finished carcasses all season.

experiences.name: Al Wafra Butcher's Pick – Australian Sheep from Kuwait Pens, Slaughtered to Order
experiences.description: Six-month supply contract, November to April, built on the Gulf custom of choosing your own animals. Sheep arrive from Western Australia on live sea shipments (about 3 weeks at sea) and are kept in our holding pens in Kabd until selected. Your butcher picks 30 head each week on a visit with our stock manager. Each animal is halal-slaughtered to order, then dressed, inspected and delivered as a whole carcass within 6 hours. Deliveries come twice weekly, never frozen, with a halal certificate per batch.

experiences.name: Shuwaikh Tannour Bakery – Arabic Bread & Regag Contract
experiences.description: Daily fresh Arabic flatbread and thin, crisp regag for both branches over six months. Dough is mixed and baked overnight at our Shuwaikh bakery on traditional tannour and saj plates. Bread is delivered daily before 10 am in clean crates, counted to your standing order.

experiences.name: Nakhlat Al Ahsa Date House – Premium Dates & Date Sweets
experiences.description: Six-month supply of premium Khalas and Sukkari dates from Al-Ahsa and Qassim, cold-stored to keep them soft. It includes date sweets for service: almond-stuffed dates, date-and-sesame rolls, and dibs for drizzling. Weekly delivery to both branches, portioned for coffee service and dessert plates.
